name: Destroyer
notes: Weapon choice: 2H sword or 2H blunt for raids, bosses and single big mobs (Crush of Doom, Fatal Strike, Frenzy's 2H bonus, Zealot's crit bonus: x2 crit damage with blunt, +100 crit rate with sword).
Weapon choice: polearm for AoE farming (Wild Sweep, then Whirlwind, then Earthquake). "Pole for trains, 2H for single targets" (l2-servera, pmfun).
The bot must switch the skill set with the weapon: with a polearm the only damage skills are Whirlwind and Earthquake, even on a single mob; with a 2H weapon Whirlwind and Earthquake are unavailable.

Raid sequence step 2: drain to <= 30 % with the frenzy_kit gear swap (Conversion weapon) or the HP-costing attacks (Crush of Doom about 250 HP each; Titan: Earthquake 340 HP, Armor Crush 338 HP) on trash.

Raid sequence step 7: fight with Armor Crush (Titan) as the opener, then Crush of Doom on cooldown, then Fatal Strike, then Hammer Crush. Healers don't heal the Destroyers above 60 % during the window: no Chant of Life, Heart of Pa'agrio or Chain Heal unless HP < 15 % (when.noFrenzyWindow on the healers' rows).
Raid sequence step 8: the window ends when Zealot ends (60 s). Re-drain after the 5-min cooldowns.
Raid sequence step 1 says toggles on before draining; the owner's toggle rule (2026-10-10, CLAUDE.md) switches toggles on only once the boss is pulled, so the toggle rows stay fightOnly.
Open question: does Frenzy activate at <= 60 % HP (this datapack) or <= 30 % (GF retail)? Cast it at 50 % and see. Cast Guts, then Frenzy, and check that only one icon stays (PINCH).

rows.trig: Titan line: Every time it's off cooldown (3 s) against the current target. Sword/blunt.
Titan line: Only if wielding fists. A future Raider should use sword/blunt plus Power Strike.
Grand Khavatari line: Spam it while wielding fists. A future Monk should level with fists.
Accuracy on only against high-evasion mobs (MP is tight at this level).
Low-HP: Frenzy (32, HP <= 60 %) when HP falls <= 60 % in a hard fight.
Low-HP row: Lionheart (36) against stunning or sleeping mobs.
Never: none.
rows.why: the guide lists no never-skill for this band

rows.trig: Priority: Crush of Doom when off cooldown, then Fatal Strike. 2H sword/blunt only (60+): 7635 power, 7 s reuse, costs about 208-261 HP and no MP. Before 60, Fatal Strike only.
Then Fatal Strike: 3653 power, 3 s, 75 MP. Before 60, Fatal Strike only.
Blunt extra: filler while Fatal Strike is on cooldown, or when a stun matters (an add on the healer). 2411 power, 50 % stun, 3 s. With a sword it is unusable, so skip it.
With a polearm Whirlwind is also the single-target skill (weapon choice: with a polearm the only damage skills are Whirlwind and Earthquake, even on a single mob).
Polearm: >= 2 mobs within 150 of yourself. PBAoE r150, 6-12 targets, 4 s.
Vicious Stance on in combat. Drop the toggles first when MP < 20 %.
War Frenzy (58+: shock/sleep resistance) on in combat. Drop the toggles first when MP < 20 %.
Polearm Accuracy (58+) only while holding a polearm (it does nothing otherwise). Drop the toggles first when MP < 20 %.
Permanent self buff: Rage in every fight (keep up).

when.text: my weapon has no attribute or a fire attribute

rows.trig: Dark Form (58+, 5 min, fire attack +20 and fire resistance) only if your weapon has no attribute or fire [?]; it competes with element weapon buffs (HOLY_ATTACK).
Raid sequence step 1: before draining (board buffs on, toggles on: Vicious Stance, War Frenzy, and Fortitude for a Titan), cast Rage.

when.text: Dark Form is useful: my weapon has no attribute or a fire attribute

rows.trig: Raid sequence step 1: plus Dark Form if useful (weapon without attribute or with fire).
Raid sequence step 1: Battle Roar only if board Bless the Body is missing. Do it now, before the drain, never inside the window.

when.text: my HP is above about 250 (Zealot costs 204 HP)

rows.trig: Raid sequence step 3 (Low-HP window row: see the raid sequence): Zealot first, after draining to <= 30 % (frenzy_kit Conversion weapon swap, or HP-costing attacks: Crush of Doom ~250 HP, Earthquake 340 HP / Armor Crush 338 HP for a Titan, on trash). It needs HP <= 30 % and itself costs 204 HP and 136 MP, so HP must be above about 250. Atk.Spd x1.3, x2 crit damage (blunt) or +100 crit rate (sword/pole), debuff resistance, halves healing received. 60 s duration, 5 min reuse.

Raid sequence step 4: Frenzy right after Zealot (90 s, 5 min reuse). Its 2H bonus holds only while HP stays <= 60 %. Draining to <= 30 % satisfies both the GF (< 30 %) and this H5 datapack (<= 60 %) [?].
Raid sequence step 4: Not Guts. Guts would overwrite Frenzy (PINCH slot). Keep Guts as the panic button for when Frenzy is on cooldown.
rows.why: never inside the Frenzy window (PINCH with Frenzy 176); see the emergency Guts row

when.text: the raid boss stuns or sleeps

rows.trig: Raid sequence step 5: Lionheart if the raid stuns or sleeps (60 s, 150 s reuse).
Emergency: Guts when HP <= 30 % with Frenzy down (the panic button for when Frenzy is on cooldown; never while Frenzy is up: PINCH).
Emergency: Battle Roar when HP < 15 % and no healer. Battle Roar heals (+35 % Max HP with heal), which ends the low-HP window.
Never: Wrath (CP only, PvP).
Never / obsolete: Power Smash once Fatal Strike is learned (Power Smash goes to Fatal Strike).
Never / obsolete: Wild Sweep once Whirlwind is learned (Wild Sweep goes to Whirlwind).
Obsolete: Stun Attack goes to Hammer Crush.
